name: Raja Ampat
blurb: Conversation about Raja Ampat is up 229% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
